Table of Contents

Namespace ParquetNeo.Serialization.Generated

Classes

MappingRegistry

Where the source generator registers the mapping of each type marked ParquetSerializableAttribute, when the assembly is loaded. The mapping is made the first time the serializer needs it. Not for use in code you write yourself.

ReadMappingBuilder<TRow>

Describes how a row type is read from columns, and gets the code that creates each object from their values. What the source generator writes for a type uses it, and nothing at run time looks at the type: no reflection, and no code is compiled. Not for use in code you write yourself.

ReadMapping<TRow>

How rows of a type are read, made by a ReadMappingBuilder<TRow>.

WriteMappingBuilder<TRow>

Describes how a row type is written as columns, and gets the code that gives the values of each object to them. What the source generator writes for a type uses it, and nothing at run time looks at the type: no reflection, and no code is compiled. Not for use in code you write yourself.

WriteMapping<TRow>

How rows of a type are written, made by a WriteMappingBuilder<TRow>.

Structs

RowSink

Where the code written by the source generator puts the values of an object: a property that is a column of its own goes to the column with its number, counted from the first column of the object, and a property that is an object, a collection or a dictionary goes to its place among the properties, counted from zero. Not for use in code you write yourself.

RowSource

Where the code written by the source generator takes the values of an object from: a property that is a column of its own is read from the column with its number, counted from the first column of the object, and a property that is an object, a collection or a dictionary from its place among the properties, counted from zero. Not for use in code you write yourself.

Delegates

AssembleRow<TRow>

Creates a row from the values of the columns, which is what the source generator writes for each type.

ShredRow<TRow>

Gives the values of a row to the columns, which is what the source generator writes for each type.
